Original image metadata · DAPI calibration

The exact run manifest points to this original morphology.ome.tif. Five HTTP206 metadata intervals (1,606 bytes) replay its first BigTIFF directory and OME XML; image pixels were not read.

Native image dimensions
54,030 × 112,160 pixels · uint16 DAPI
XY calibration
0.2125 µm/pixel · OME and run manifest agree
Declared optical planes
16 · 3.0 µm Z step · XYZCT order
Source cell centroids in image bounds
182,698 / 182,698 · continuous pixel coordinates
Named outline areas reproduced
29 / 29 · original µm² header precision

The source float32 matrix is used unchanged, with no pixel rounding or clamping. Its maximum difference from division by the exact XY calibration is 0.003217 pixels in X and 0.006681 in Y. All centroids fit the image domain; this does not verify segmentation against image pixels.

Each named outline’s shoelace area reproduces its own source header at one decimal. This supports dimensional consistency; it does not prove a shared origin, rotation, cell-to-section mapping or donor assignment. Sixteen declared optical planes do not establish biological section thickness, and the remaining TIFF directories and pyramid pixels were not inspected.

Exact original morphology file · OME metadata format

Source metadata only. Section identity, donor, curated type, outline frame and applicable rights remain unresolved; no image, cell geometry, 3D anatomy or atlas registration is admitted.
